title: Low-Stock Alerts
summary: A Google Sheet that knows when each product will run out and emails purchasing before it happens.
result: Stock-outs are caught 1 to 3 weeks early, with a suggested order quantity for every product.

metric.label: of warning before a product runs out

note: Demo built with fictitious store data; the warning time comes from the simulated sales and supplier lead times.

screenshots.alt: Stock sheet: days of cover, reorder point, suggested order and status per SKU
Daily alert email listing products to reorder now and this week

upworkBlurb: Low-stock alerts in Google Sheets + Apps Script for a small online store. Daily sales are imported, and every product gets days of stock left, a reorder point based on supplier lead time and a suggested order quantity. Every morning a script emails purchasing the products that will run out before a new order can arrive, 1 to 3 weeks ahead (simulated data). No paid apps; works with a Shopify or any store export. Stack: Google Sheets, Apps Script, Gmail.
